text: Underway in the RFL today.
CR-7000 radios: 'attacking the ball'!
And straight away, Buffon.exe breaks clean through! No white shirts in sight, just the open net beckoning for Dynamo Datacenter!
Real Machina sitting on top after that thrilling opening-day win over Singularity United, but Dynamo in yellow are looking to make their own mark in fixture two.
Mbapp-E loses footing and tumbles.
Teammates collide! Buffon.exe hits deck.
Buffon.exe clatters straight into CR-7000, sending the Real Machina talisman sprawling across the turf!
CR-7000: 'pushing along the wall'.
GOAL! A disastrous own goal from Buffon.exe, turning it into his own net! Real Machina take the lead, it's one-nil!
Buffon.exe hits the deck again.
GOAL! You cannot write this! An own goal off Mbapp-E this time! A calamitous sequence for Dynamo Datacenter, and Real Machina lead two-nil!
Two own goals inside eighty seconds. Dynamo Datacenter's algorithms seem completely scrambled in this opening half, while Real Machina cruise without having taken a clean shot.
Zidroid is slipped clean through on goal here! An open lane towards the target for the white shirt!
Thump! The corner ram triggers with authority, firing the magenta ball back into midfield.
'Pushing it off the wall,' radios Buffon.exe, trying to salvage some order out of a bruising opening period.
A momentary lull deep in the Real Machina half. The Unitree humanoids recalibrating their balance routines after a frantic, chaotic start.
CR-7000 comes over the comms: 'helping push it out' as they scrap by the boundary.
And the corner panel springs to life, blasting the ball away from the dead-zone with a mechanical crunch!
Once more the corner wall engages, denying any lingering in the corner.
Buffon.exe bursts through on goal! A glorious chance to make amends for Dynamo Datacenter!
Mbapp-E radios to his partner: 'got your back on the wall.' Good communication in yellow, trying to mount a comeback.
Friendly fire! Zidroid goes down!
CR-7000 flattens Mbapp-E!
The corner ram slams out the ball amidst the pile-up!
There is the half-time whistle. Real Machina lead Dynamo Datacenter two-nil courtesy of two rather unfortunate own goals.
GOAL! Unbelievable! It's another own goal by Buffon.exe! A hat-trick of own goals for Dynamo Datacenter, and Real Machina are three-nil up!
GOAL! Another own goal from Mbapp-E! Real Machina lead four-nil!
Mbapp-E radios 'clearing it away from our goal'—well, the actuators had other ideas there, completely misfiring into the net.
Zidroid through on goal again with acres of space!
The powered ram fires it out before Zidroid can pull the trigger.
Real Machina look completely in command of fixture two, on course for six points at the summit of the RFL Mini League.
Mbapp-E radios: 'prying it free' along the boards.
GOAL! Now an own goal at the other end! CR-7000 bundles it into his own net! Dynamo Datacenter get on the board, it's four-one!
GOAL! Buffon.exe puts it into his own net yet again! Five-one to Real Machina in the most bizarre own-goal bonanza you'll ever witness!
Zidroid clean through on goal!
Zidroid wipes Buffon.exe out!
CR-7000 collides and tumbles!
And Mbapp-E falls over completely unprovoked! All four humanoids struggling for equilibrium in an absolute heap of titanium!
CR-7000 levels Buffon.exe with a crunching challenge right in the centre!
The corner push-panel launches the ball back out into open play with a solid thud.
Retribution from Buffon.exe, taking CR-7000 off his feet with a heavy shoulder barge!
CR-7000 tries to pivot and immediately loses his balance, hitting the deck.
CR-7000: 'helping free stuck ball'.
The corner ram triggers instantly, saving anyone the trouble of prying it loose.
Zidroid comes flying in and sends Mbapp-E crashing to the floor. No quarter given even with time winding down.
Just inches wide of the post! That was agonizingly close to finding the bottom corner!
GOAL! A proper finish at last! CR-7000 slots it home into the far corner to make it six-one to Real Machina!
GOAL! Zidroid gets on the scoresheet now, drilling it past the recovering yellow shirts! Seven-one to Real Machina!
Full-time: Real Machina seven, Dynamo Datacenter one, as the league leaders put on an unforgettable show.
